deadlines.dateText: Applicants who are neither EU/EFTA nationals nor hold an EU/EFTA university degree Applications open in February for entry the following October resp. August for entry the following April. Deadline: 15 April for entry the following October resp. 15 October for entry the following April EU/EFTA applicants and applicants holding an EU/EFTA university degree Applications open in May for entry the following October resp. November for entry the following April. Deadline: 1 July for entry the following October resp. 1 January for entry the following April.
